route pairs (LB-F168, LB-F169): a route joins the declarations of its nearest compose project (the route file's directory, then each ancestor), one pair for every compose file of that directory that declares the service, read by docker compose config 5.1.4 (--no-consistency); scored by lang-routes under -only, which restricts the measured dialect's files and not the compose files a target joins to; the subject set holds at least 10 pairs, the floor under which one miss moves xref_precision by 10 points: envoyproxy/examples joins 84 pairs and fathom draws 83 (78 in the truth; 5 extra join one sandbox's cluster to other sandboxes' services, O435; 6 missed in ext_authz bootstraps no name claims, O348), supabase/supabase joins 10 and fathom reads none (the single-quoted '@type' fails the Envoy content sniff, O436)
